en: The tail flip warns you: sidestep or leave the area before it bursts.

en: You can see where it will land. It takes a long time to recover after landing: punish it.
es: Se ve dónde va a caer. Tras aterrizar tarda mucho en recuperarse: castígalo.

keys: The fist frosts over first: back off or dodge backwards.
en: The fist frosts over first: back off or dodge backwards.
es: El puño se carga de escarcha antes: retrocede o esquiva hacia atrás.

keys: Jump when the wave reaches you. You can see it coming: the body rises first.
en: Jump when the wave reaches you. You can see it coming: the body rises first.
es: Salta cuando la onda llegue a ti. Se ve venir: levanta el cuerpo antes.

keys: While asleep it takes 35% more damage and cannot defend itself: attack now.
en: While asleep it takes 35% more damage and cannot defend itself: attack now.
es: Dormido recibe un 35 % más y no puede defenderse: es el momento de atacar.

keys: It is long and turns slowly: you cannot back out of it, so circle around it. It stays still for a moment at the end.
en: It is long and turns slowly: you cannot back out of it, so circle around it. It stays still for a moment at the end.
es: Es largo y gira lento: hacia atrás no se sale, rodéalo por un lado. Al acabar se queda quieto un momento.

keys: It is wide but flat: you can jump over it.
en: It is wide but flat: you can jump over it.
es: Es ancha pero plana: se puede saltar por encima.

keys: Short range: keeping your distance shuts it down.
en: Short range: keeping your distance shuts it down.
es: Corto alcance: guardar la distancia lo anula.

keys: It catches fire before setting off and goes straight: step aside. If it misses, it is wide open.
en: It catches fire before setting off and goes straight: step aside. If it misses, it is wide open.
es: Arde antes de salir y va en línea recta: apártate de lado. Si falla, queda muy expuesto.

keys: Almost no warning, but it goes straight: one step to the side is enough. If it misses, it stops dead.
en: Almost no warning, but it goes straight: one step to the side is enough. If it misses, it stops dead.
es: Sale casi sin aviso pero en línea recta: un paso de lado basta. Si falla, queda quieto.

keys: The water gathers first. It turns very slowly: step out of the line sideways.
en: The water gathers first. It turns very slowly: step out of the line sideways.
es: Antes se acumula el agua. Gira muy despacio: sal de la línea de lado.

keys: It steers poorly: jump over it or dodge when it arrives.
en: It steers poorly: jump over it or dodge when it arrives.
es: Gira con poca precisión: salta por encima o esquiva cuando llegue.

keys: Long reach but in a line: it misses from the side. After the pull, dodge before the next hit.
en: Long reach but in a line: it misses from the side. After the pull, dodge before the next hit.
es: Alcanza lejos pero en línea: de lado no llega. Tras el tirón, esquiva antes del siguiente golpe.

keys: They spread out with distance: from far away, slip between them.
en: They spread out with distance: from far away, slip between them.
es: Se abren con la distancia: lejos, pasa entre ellas.

keys: The ground shows where it lands: leave the circle. Afterwards, do not step in the puddle.
en: The ground shows where it lands: leave the circle. Afterwards, do not step in the puddle.
es: El suelo marca dónde cae: sal del círculo. Después, no pises el charco.

keys: Uncharged, you cannot outrun it: dodge it when it is close. Charged, it goes straight: get out of its line.
en: Uncharged, you cannot outrun it: dodge it when it is close. Charged, it goes straight: get out of its line.
es: Sin cargar no se escapa corriendo: esquívala cuando esté cerca. Cargada va recta: apártate de su línea.

keys: The fist glows first: step aside. If it misses, Lucario is exposed.
en: The fist glows first: step aside. If it misses, Lucario is exposed.
es: El puño brilla antes: apártate de lado. Si falla, queda expuesto.

keys: Almost no warning, but it goes straight: move sideways. When it ends, turn around.
en: Almost no warning, but it goes straight: move sideways. When it ends, turn around.
es: Casi no avisa, pero va en línea recta: muévete de lado. Al acabar, date la vuelta.

keys: Do not attack right when it glows: wait for it to end and punish.
en: Do not attack right when it glows: wait for it to end and punish.
es: No ataques justo cuando brilla: espera a que acabe y castiga.

keys: It barely turns: a well-timed change of direction leaves it behind.
en: It barely turns: a well-timed change of direction leaves it behind.
es: Gira poco: un cambio de dirección a tiempo la deja atrás.

keys: The cracks in the ground show where it is: move away or jump when it is about to come out. It is slow to react after emerging.
en: The cracks in the ground show where it is: move away or jump when it is about to come out. It is slow to react after emerging.
es: Las grietas del suelo dicen dónde está: apártate o salta cuando vaya a salir. Al salir tarda en reaccionar.

keys: The cracks mark the line: get off it or jump the spikes.
en: The cracks mark the line: get off it or jump the spikes.
es: Las grietas marcan la línea: sal de ella o salta las estacas.

keys: They come one at a time: move in a curve, not a straight line.
en: They come one at a time: move in a curve, not a straight line.
es: Llegan de uno en uno: muévete en curva, no en línea recta.

keys: It leaves smoke as it vanishes: turn to the side and dodge.
en: It leaves smoke as it vanishes: turn to the side and dodge.
es: Deja humo al irse: date la vuelta hacia el lado y esquiva.

keys: Almost no warning, but it is light: it does not interrupt moves with poise.
en: Almost no warning, but it is light: it does not interrupt moves with poise.
es: Casi no avisa pero es ligero: no corta lo que tenga aguante.

keys: The pincers open first: take a step back.
en: The pincers open first: take a step back.
es: Las pinzas se abren antes: retrocede un paso.

keys: It cannot defend itself while dancing: punish it. Afterwards, watch out for its two boosted hits.
en: It cannot defend itself while dancing: punish it. Afterwards, watch out for its two boosted hits.
es: Mientras baila no se defiende: castígalo. Después, cuidado con sus dos golpes.
Corto y en línea: apártate de lado.

keys: Huge and slow. Soaks up damage, takes up space and punishes every mistake.
en: Huge and slow. Soaks up damage, takes up space and punishes every mistake.
es: Enorme y lento. Aguanta, ocupa el espacio y castiga cada error.

keys: Mid-range pressure. Flies while its stamina lasts; it can never stay up forever.
en: Mid-range pressure. Flies while its stamina lasts; it can never stay up forever.
es: Presión a media distancia. Vuela mientras le dura el aguante; nunca se queda arriba siempre.

keys: Heavy. Controls lines with water and ice and punishes hard from range.
en: Heavy. Controls lines with water and ice and punishes hard from range.
es: Pesado. Controla líneas con agua y hielo y castiga fuerte desde lejos.

keys: Slow zoner. Long reach, fouls the ground and punishes anyone who gets careless.
en: Slow zoner. Long reach, fouls the ground and punishes anyone who gets careless.
es: Lento y de zona. Alcanza lejos, ensucia el suelo y castiga a quien se confía.

keys: Precise close-range fighter. Gets in fast, punishes and counters.
en: Precise close-range fighter. Gets in fast, punishes and counters.
es: Cuerpo a cuerpo y preciso. Entra rápido, castiga y contraataca.

keys: Slippery. Harasses from range, tricks and shows up where you least expect it.
en: Slippery. Harasses from range, tricks and shows up where you least expect it.
es: Escurridizo. Hostiga de lejos, engaña y aparece donde no se le espera.

keys: Aggressive and fast on the ground. Strikes from below and gives no breathing room.
en: Aggressive and fast on the ground. Strikes from below and gives no breathing room.
es: Agresivo y rápido por el suelo. Entra desde abajo y no deja respirar.

keys: Ninja. Never stops moving, throws from range and comes in from the sides.
en: Ninja. Never stops moving, throws from range and comes in from the sides.
es: Ninja. Se mueve sin parar, lanza desde lejos y entra por los lados.

keys: Close-range pressure with short advances. Punishes every mistake with its pincers.
en: Close-range pressure with short advances. Punishes every mistake with its pincers.
es: Presión de cerca con avances cortos. Castiga cada error con las pinzas.

keys: Takes the type of the last move it used, which changes its weaknesses. Shown by the icons on its frame.
en: Takes the type of the last move it used, which changes its weaknesses. Shown by the icons on its frame.
es: Toma el tipo del último movimiento que usa: cambian sus debilidades. Se ve en los iconos de su marco.

keys: Against the AI. Pick your Pokémon, the rival and the difficulty.
en: Against the AI. Pick your Pokémon, the rival and the difficulty.

en: Your friend joins with your IP. Port 7777 (UDP).

en: Each time a hit cuts one of its moves short (it flinches), its Speed rises one stage (x1.5 for the battle).

keys: At a third of its HP or less, its Water moves hit 1.5 times as hard.
en: At a third of its HP or less, its Water moves hit 1.5 times as hard.
es: Con un tercio de sus PS o menos, sus movimientos de tipo Agua pegan 1,5 veces más.

keys: At a third of its HP or less, its Grass moves hit 1.5 times as hard.

en: It does not flinch: its moves need one more step of strength to be cut short.

es: Cuánto vuela la Poké Ball si el Pokémon está al otro extremo del campo. Mientras tanto aún se le puede golpear.

keys: How long the one coming in cannot act. It has no invulnerability.
en: How long the one coming in cannot act. It has no invulnerability.
es: Cuánto tarda en poder actuar el que entra. No es invulnerable.

keys: How long the Pokémon that left has to wait before it can come back. It does not hold after a KO.
en: How long the Pokémon that left has to wait before it can come back. It does not hold after a KO.
es: Cuánto debe esperar el Pokémon que salió antes de poder volver. No cuenta tras un K.O.

keys: How many switches each side starts with.
en: How many switches each side starts with.
es: Con cuántos cambios empieza cada bando.

keys: How many switches a side can hold.
en: How many switches a side can hold.
es: Cuántos cambios puede acumular un bando.

keys: How long a new switch takes to come. A switch cut short by a hit still costs it.
en: How long a new switch takes to come. A switch cut short by a hit still costs it.
es: Cuánto tarda en llegar un cambio nuevo. Un cambio interrumpido por un golpe también se gasta.

keys: How much sooner the next switch comes for each hit you land.
en: How much sooner the next switch comes for each hit you land.
es: Cuánto antes llega el siguiente cambio por cada golpe que aciertes.

keys: How much of its max HP a Pokémon on the bench gets back each second. Fainted ones do not.
en: How much of its max HP a Pokémon on the bench gets back each second. Fainted ones do not.
es: Qué parte de sus PS máximos recupera cada segundo un Pokémon en el banquillo. Los debilitados no.

keys: Time to pick the next one
en: Time to pick the next one

keys: How long you have to pick. Out of time, the healthiest one comes out.
en: How long you have to pick. Out of time, the healthiest one comes out.
es: Cuánto tienes para elegir. Si se acaba, sale el que tenga más salud.

keys: How long the next one cannot be hit once it is out.
en: How long the next one cannot be hit once it is out.
es: Cuánto tiempo no se puede golpear al siguiente una vez fuera.

keys: How much energy the team that lost a Pokémon gets.
en: How much energy the team that lost a Pokémon gets.
es: Cuánta energía recibe el equipo que perdió un Pokémon.
El campo de la Liga se cierra más lento

keys: How many times slower the League Stadium's field closes in. At 1 it closes as in a 1 vs 1.
en: How many times slower the League Stadium's field closes in. At 1 it closes as in a 1 vs 1.
es: Cuántas veces más lento se cierra el campo del Estadio de la Liga. Con 1 se cierra como en un 1 contra 1.

keys: With nothing locked on and the crosshair over the foe: turning the camera gets slower and the aim follows the foe a little, so it is harder to slip off. The higher, the stronger.
en: With nothing locked on and the crosshair over the foe: turning the camera gets slower and the aim follows the foe a little, so it is harder to slip off. The higher, the stronger.
es: Sin nada fijado y con el punto de mira sobre el rival: la cámara gira más despacio y la mira sigue un poco al rival, así cuesta más salirse. Cuanto más alto, más fuerte.

keys: On, nobody can lock on: the button does nothing and the camera stays free. The AI still aims on its own.
en: On, nobody can lock on: the button does nothing and the camera stays free. The AI still aims on its own.
es: Con Sí, nadie puede fijar objetivo: el botón no hace nada y la cámara queda libre. La IA sigue apuntando por su cuenta.

keys: With nothing locked on. Off, moves go exactly where the crosshair in the center of the screen points, up and down too. On, the old way: moves stay level and shots home in on the rival.
en: With nothing locked on. Off, moves go exactly where the crosshair in the center of the screen points, up and down too. On, the old way: moves stay level and shots home in on the rival.
es: Sin nada fijado. Con No, los movimientos van justo adonde apunta el punto de mira del centro de la pantalla, también arriba y abajo. Con Sí, a la antigua: los movimientos van a nivel y los disparos persiguen al rival.

keys: Three Pokémon a side, one on the field at a time. Switch between them.
en: Three Pokémon a side, one on the field at a time. Switch between them.
es: Tres Pokémon por bando, uno en el campo cada vez. Cambia entre ellos.

keys: Puts every rule back on its default.
en: Puts every rule back on its default.
es: Devuelve cada regla a su valor por defecto.

keys: 1 vs 1 or 3 vs 3 with a friend over the internet.
en: 1 vs 1 or 3 vs 3 with a friend over the internet.
es: 1 contra 1 o 3 contra 3 con un amigo por internet.
Las reglas las pone el anfitrión.

keys: A ring of water that widens as it flies. It can confuse.
en: A ring of water that widens as it flies. It can confuse.
es: Un anillo de agua que se ensancha al volar. Puede confundir.

keys: A straight shot of mud. It always lowers the target's Speed.
en: A straight shot of mud. It always lowers the target's Speed.
es: Un disparo recto de lodo. Siempre baja la Velocidad del rival.

keys: A lobbed glob of acid. It always sharply lowers the target's Sp. Def.
en: A lobbed glob of acid. It always sharply lowers the target's Sp. Def.
es: Lanza en parábola una masa de ácido. Siempre baja mucho la Def. Esp. del rival.

keys: The further it goes the wider it gets: step aside early or dodge through it.
en: The further it goes the wider it gets: step aside early or dodge through it.
es: Cuanto más lejos llega, más ancho es: apártate pronto o atraviésalo con la esquiva.

keys: It is slow and arcs: walk out from under it or dodge through it.
en: It is slow and arcs: walk out from under it or dodge through it.
es: Es lenta y va en arco: sal de debajo o atraviésala con la esquiva.

keys: Heavy and slimy. Controls the mid range with water and ice, and whoever hits it up close gets slower and slower.
en: Heavy and slimy. Controls the mid range with water and ice, and whoever hits it up close gets slower and slower.
es: Pesado y viscoso. Controla la media distancia con agua e hielo, y quien lo golpea de cerca se vuelve cada vez más lento.

keys: Each contact move that hits it lowers the attacker's Speed one stage for the battle.
en: Each contact move that hits it lowers the attacker's Speed one stage for the battle.
es: Cada movimiento de contacto que lo golpea baja un nivel la Velocidad del atacante durante el combate.

keys: Grass moves do nothing to it and raise its Attack one stage (x1.5 for the battle).
en: Grass moves do nothing to it and raise its Attack one stage (x1.5 for the battle).
es: Los movimientos de tipo Planta no le hacen nada y suben un nivel su Ataque (x1,5 durante el combate).

keys: In the rain it cures its status condition at the end of every turn (3 s).
en: In the rain it cures its status condition at the end of every turn (3 s).
es: Con lluvia cura su problema de estado al final de cada turno (3 s).

keys: The sandstorm does not hurt it, and powder moves do nothing to it.
en: The sandstorm does not hurt it, and powder moves do nothing to it.
es: La tormenta de arena no le hace daño y los movimientos de polvos no le afectan.

keys: With nothing locked on, marks where your moves go.
en: With nothing locked on, marks where your moves go.
es: Sin nada fijado, marca adónde van tus movimientos.

keys: A dot with four ticks round it, or a dot in a ring.
en: A dot with four ticks round it, or a dot in a ring.
es: Un punto con cuatro marcas alrededor, o un punto dentro de un anillo.

keys: A single masterful punch. It is always a critical hit: it ignores the target's raised defenses and the user's lowered Attack.
en: A single masterful punch. It is always a critical hit: it ignores the target's raised defenses and the user's lowered Attack.
es: Un único puñetazo magistral. Siempre es crítico: ignora las defensas subidas del objetivo y el Ataque bajado del usuario.

keys: Three flowing blows of water. Each one is always a critical hit.
en: Three flowing blows of water. Each one is always a critical hit.
es: Tres golpes fluidos de agua. Cada uno es siempre crítico.

keys: A sudden dash that only works if the target is preparing an attack. Otherwise it fails and leaves the user open.
en: A sudden dash that only works if the target is preparing an attack. Otherwise it fails and leaves the user open.
es: Una embestida repentina que solo funciona si el objetivo está preparando un ataque. Si no, falla y deja al usuario expuesto.

keys: Lashes out in anger. Double power for 3 s after one of its stats is lowered. If it misses, the user is left wide open.
en: Lashes out in anger. Double power for 3 s after one of its stats is lowered. If it misses, the user is left wide open.
es: Arremete con rabia. Doble de potencia durante 3 s después de que le bajen una característica. Si falla, el usuario queda muy expuesto.

keys: A barrier that stops every move for a moment. It does not hurt the attacker. If nothing comes, it is open.
en: A barrier that stops every move for a moment. It does not hurt the attacker. If nothing comes, it is open.
es: Una barrera que detiene todos los movimientos durante un momento. No daña al atacante. Si no llega nada, queda expuesto.

keys: Braces for a physical hit: it takes the damage and pays it back double. Special moves break through.
en: Braces for a physical hit: it takes the damage and pays it back double. Special moves break through.
es: Se prepara para un golpe físico: recibe el daño y lo devuelve doble. Los movimientos especiales lo atraviesan.

keys: Tenses its muscles, open to hits: Attack and Defense rise one stage. Three times per battle.
en: Tenses its muscles, open to hits: Attack and Defense rise one stage. Three times per battle.
es: Tensa los músculos, expuesto a los golpes: suben un nivel el Ataque y la Defensa. Tres veces por combate.

keys: Crashes into the target wrapped in water. It can lower its Defense.
en: Crashes into the target wrapped in water. It can lower its Defense.
es: Choca contra el objetivo envuelto en agua. Puede bajarle la Defensa.

keys: A burst of icy water. It always lowers the target's Attack.
en: A burst of icy water. It always lowers the target's Attack.
es: Un chorro de agua helada. Siempre baja el Ataque del objetivo.

keys: The fist darkens first and the lunge goes straight: dodge through it and punish.
en: The fist darkens first and the lunge goes straight: dodge through it and punish.
es: Primero se oscurece el puño y la embestida va recta: esquívala atravesándola y castiga.

keys: It only reaches a few meters: back off or dodge through, and punish when it stops.
en: It only reaches a few meters: back off or dodge through, and punish when it stops.
es: Solo llega a unos metros: retrocede o esquiva atravesándolo, y castiga cuando pare.

keys: Do not attack into it: wait for the dash, and punish the long recovery when it fails.
en: Do not attack into it: wait for the dash, and punish the long recovery when it fails.
es: No ataques contra él: espera la embestida y castiga su larga recuperación cuando falle.

keys: It glows red while it is doubled and the wind-up is long: dodge it, then punish its very long recovery.
en: It glows red while it is doubled and the wind-up is long: dodge it, then punish its very long recovery.
es: Brilla en rojo mientras está doblado y la preparación es larga: esquívalo y castiga su larguísima recuperación.

keys: Hold your attack until the barrier fades, then punish. Contact moves with Unseen Fist go through.
en: Hold your attack until the barrier fades, then punish. Contact moves with Unseen Fist go through.
es: Aguanta el ataque hasta que se desvanezca la barrera y castiga. Los movimientos de contacto con Puño Invisible la atraviesan.

keys: Use a special move or attack from afar. If nothing comes, it is left open.
en: Use a special move or attack from afar. If nothing comes, it is left open.
es: Usa un movimiento especial o ataca de lejos. Si no llega nada, queda expuesto.

keys: It cannot defend itself while flexing: punish it.
en: It cannot defend itself while flexing: punish it.
es: No puede defenderse mientras se tensa: castígalo.

keys: Suds gather first and it goes straight: step aside. If it misses, punish.
en: Suds gather first and it goes straight: step aside. If it misses, punish.
es: Primero se forma espuma y va recto: hazte a un lado. Si falla, castiga.

keys: One perfect blow. It reads the rival's attack and answers with a hit no guard or stat can soften.
en: One perfect blow. It reads the rival's attack and answers with a hit no guard or stat can soften.
es: Un golpe perfecto. Lee el ataque del rival y responde con un impacto que ninguna guardia ni característica puede suavizar.

keys: Flowing water. Wears the rival down with flurries and chills its strength from afar.
en: Flowing water. Wears the rival down with flurries and chills its strength from afar.
es: Agua que fluye. Desgasta al rival con ráfagas de golpes y enfría su fuerza desde lejos.

keys: Its contact moves go through Protect and Detect.
en: Its contact moves go through Protect and Detect.
es: Sus movimientos de contacto atraviesan Protección y Detección.

en: Urshifu's model: the Pokemans Pack team (CC BY-NC 4.0; converted, animations cut, one texture recolored)

en: A tiny spark from the eyes, at close range. Every move of the target not already cooling down has to wait 3 s.

keys: A swipe sends a ripple of psychic energy forward, close and wide. It always confuses.
en: A swipe sends a ripple of psychic energy forward, close and wide. It always confuses.
es: Un gesto de la mano lanza una onda de energía psíquica hacia delante, corta y ancha. Siempre confunde.

keys: Vanishes and reappears a fixed distance away, the way it last moved. It cannot be hit while gone.
en: Vanishes and reappears a fixed distance away, the way it last moved. It cannot be hit while gone.
es: Desaparece y reaparece a una distancia fija, hacia donde se movió por última vez. Mientras no está, no se le puede golpear.

keys: A shard of psychic force. It is measured against the target's Defense, not its Sp. Def.
en: A shard of psychic force. It is measured against the target's Defense, not its Sp. Def.
es: Una esquirla de fuerza psíquica. Se mide contra la Defensa del objetivo, no contra su Def. Esp.

keys: Calms its mind, open to hits: Sp. Atk and Sp. Def rise one stage. Twice per battle.
en: Calms its mind, open to hits: Sp. Atk and Sp. Def rise one stage. Twice per battle.
es: Calma su mente, expuesto a los golpes: el At. Esp. y la Def. Esp. suben un nivel. Dos veces por combate.

keys: Relaxes its body and moves much faster: Speed rises two stages. Once per battle.
en: Relaxes its body and moves much faster: Speed rises two stages. Once per battle.
es: Relaja el cuerpo y se mueve mucho más rápido: la Velocidad sube dos niveles. Una vez por combate.

keys: The eyes flash first and it barely reaches: step back or dodge through it, then punish. If it lands, you can still move.
en: The eyes flash first and it barely reaches: step back or dodge through it, then punish. If it lands, you can still move.
es: Primero le brillan los ojos y apenas llega: retrocede o esquívalo y castiga. Si te da, aún puedes moverte.

keys: It only reaches a few meters: stay out of it. Once confused you are safe from another for a moment.
en: It only reaches a few meters: stay out of it. Once confused you are safe from another for a moment.
es: Solo llega a unos metros: mantente fuera. Tras una confusión estás a salvo de otra durante un momento.

keys: It always goes the way it was moving: be there when it comes back, and punish.
en: It always goes the way it was moving: be there when it comes back, and punish.
es: Siempre va hacia donde se estaba moviendo: espéralo allí cuando vuelva y castígalo.

keys: It flies straight and does not turn: sidestep it or dodge through it.
en: It flies straight and does not turn: sidestep it or dodge through it.
es: Va recta y no gira: se esquiva moviéndose de lado o con la esquiva.

keys: It cannot defend itself while it concentrates: punish it.
en: It cannot defend itself while it concentrates: punish it.
es: No puede defenderse mientras se concentra: castígalo.

keys: Hit it in that short moment. Afterwards, lower its Speed or cover ground with area moves.
en: Hit it in that short moment. Afterwards, lower its Speed or cover ground with area moves.
es: Golpéalo en ese breve momento. Después, bájale la Velocidad o cubre terreno con movimientos de área.

en: Overwhelming psychic power at any range. It takes away the rival's moves and its footing, and is gone before the answer comes.
es: Un poder psíquico abrumador a cualquier distancia. Le quita al rival sus movimientos y su equilibrio, y ya no está cuando llega la respuesta.

keys: While it is in play, the rival's moves take 10% longer to come back.
en: While it is in play, the rival's moves take 10% longer to come back.
es: Mientras está en combate, los movimientos del rival tardan un 10% más en volver.

en: Flies into a rage and throws itself at the rival three times. Then it is confused: its attacks change buttons for a while.
es: Monta en cólera y se lanza tres veces contra el rival. Después queda confuso: sus ataques cambian de botón un rato.
